local_review.finding_body: The test build declared org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-http-codec:4.1.0-RC1 directly. This violated the version-agnostic test requirement because the shared test would retain that exact companion version when the tested Spring Boot version advances.
local_review.finding_title: Companion test dependency pinned to the requested library version
local_review.fix_note: Replaced the hardcoded spring-boot-http-codec version with the TCK-resolved libraryVersion, then ran Forge finalization to a successful no-change pass.
local_review.review_comment: Confirmed the diff is scoped to one coordinate and uses only reachability-metadata.json; the public, package-separated test exercises WebClient behavior without native skips, unsupported-feature tolerance, reflection shortcuts, or version-pinned assertions. The reported 0/0 dynamic-access result is a valid no-calls case, so the percentage and entry-count mismatch gates do not apply. Local index evidence was green, and the stable Forge finalization pass completed all three native lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation.
